journey.name: Detail navigation and scroll restoration
journey.description: New detail screens start at the top and returning restores the discovery position.

actions.action: Open the app and complete onboarding
Scroll to the discovery catalogue
Open the first catalogue place
Verify that the place detail screen starts at the top
Tap the detail back button
Verify that discovery returns to its previous scroll position

journey.name: Primary tab navigation
journey.description: Every primary tab opens at its own top position without carrying scroll from another page.

actions.action: Scroll down on Discover
Tap the Trips tab
Verify that Trips starts at the top
Scroll down on Trips
Tap the Guides tab
Verify that Guides starts at the top

journey.name: Direct detail fallback and modal dismissal
journey.description: Direct links have a safe back destination and modal state does not leak into navigation.

actions.action: Open a guide profile directly
Tap the detail back button
Verify that the Guides page opens at the top
Open the sign-in sheet
Verify that background scrolling is locked
Dismiss the sign-in sheet with Escape
Verify that background scrolling is restored

journey.name: Built-in map
journey.description: The map loads inside GoUG and exposes every mapped place without leaving the app.

actions.action: Open the Map tab
Wait for the interactive map
Verify that Uganda place markers are visible

journey.name: Booking request and confirmation
journey.description: A traveller can request a place and the content studio can confirm it without payment.

actions.action: Request availability for Bwindi
Verify the pending request in Trips
Confirm the request in Content studio
Verify the confirmed request in Trips

journey.name: Guide messaging and preferences
journey.description: Guide conversations and traveller preferences persist through navigation.

actions.action: Send a message to a guide
Update language and currency
Verify preferences were persisted

journey.name: Review moderation
journey.description: The content studio can publish a pending traveller review and the public place page displays it.

actions.action: Seed a pending traveller review
Publish the review in Content studio
Verify the review appears on the place page
